🧩 ELI5 Kata · Break the pieces (C++, 2 kyu)

Given an ASCII blueprint of nested rooms (+, -, |, spaces), how do we slice out every minimal closed room and heal its shared walls?

https://github.com/8b-is/space-bender/tree/main/katas/2kyu/break-the-pieces

🌊 ELI5 Step 1 (Pouring Water Outside):

First, pad the blueprint with a 1-space border and flood-fill from `(0, 0)`.
Every space the water reaches is "outside".
Each dry pocket of spaces left inside is a minimal closed room!

🧱 ELI5 Step 2 (8-Neighbor Walls & Corner Healing):

Walk the 8-neighbors of a room's dry spaces to collect its wall cells (`bnd_stamp`).
Did a `+` T-junction belong to a neighbor's wall? If it only has horizontal neighbors in THIS room's wall, it heals to `-` (or `|` for vertical)!

✅ Verified in C++20 across nested donuts, interlocking L-rooms & classic grids!

https://github.com/8b-is/space-bender/blob/main/katas/2kyu/break-the-pieces/solution.cpp
